pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygons with soft, diffuse pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger, vertically elongated shapes on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, more circular clusters toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological graph of cream-colored pathways. The network exhibits variable pixel thickness with high-contrast junction nodes, primarily forming tri-valent and quadri-valent intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, upright bristled silhouette along the dorsal midline of the neck, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical pixel projections against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, high-contrast dark punctate feature is visible on the mid-flank, representing either a localized textural anomaly or a temporal parasitic presence.
